Use case: compositing. Asset type: polished product photograph for the Unmet Needs chapter of the Adzoy medical website.
Edit Image 1, the existing background, by integrating the ORIGINAL real Adzoy carton(s) supplied as the supporting images. This is a photographic retouch/composite, not a packaging redesign. Keep the carton proportions, recognizable printed artwork, exact Arabic/English typography, original logos, ingredients, dose strengths and colors; do not invent any text. The final result must look like ONE photograph, with coherent soft upper-left daylight, warm ivory bounce light from the stone, gentle lavender environmental color, realistic matte-coated printed cardboard, slightly softened high-frequency edges consistent with the camera, physically correct contact/occlusion shadow directly touching the carton bases, and soft cast shadows trailing toward the back-right. Remove the cutout/pasted-on appearance. No glowing halos and no floating objects. Preserve the recognizable environment and props from Image 1, but compose them naturally around the real cartons.
Output one single clean high-resolution image, landscape 4:3 framing, no UI, no caption, no added text or borders. Frame complete cartons and their touching floor contact at x roughly 30–70% and y 12–73% so the complete products survive modest central crops on the website; leave lower 20% visually quiet stone for a caption that will be rendered separately. Keep product faces crisply readable. Do not add tubes, generic packages, extra cartons, badges, or medical claims.
Image 2 is the only carton to insert: the original PINK Arabic Adzoy 0.1%/2.5% carton. Place it upright slightly left of center on the stone vanity, with its entire base physically resting on the same surface as the clock and towel. Keep the crescent lamp and clock visible to its right, towel and flowers to its left. The moon lamp gives a very subtle warm bounce on the carton's right edge; maintain the original pink and blue print. Use natural believable relative scale, not a giant carton. Preserve the quiet evening routine setting.
